primary_quality_metric.definition: best feasible objective present when the run has completed exactly physical_fes_per_run complete-layout physical evaluations

feasibility_reporting.no_feasible_layout_policy: primary quality metric is null; retain the least-violation layout and complete violation vector; never silently convert a penalty value into a feasible objective

convergence_reporting.checkpoint_mapping: ceil(fraction * physical_fes_per_run), deduplicated in ascending complete-layout physical-FES order

timing_reporting.algorithm_definition: optimizer, learning, variation, repair, selection, synchronization, and serialization work excluding complete-layout evaluator wall time
timing_reporting.end_to_end_definition: complete optimization-run wall time including evaluator, algorithm, synchronization, and measured orchestration overhead
timing_reporting.quality_separation_rule: wall time is reported as performance evidence only and is never used as a quality metric, solution selector, quality rank, or optimization objective

per_exact_case_seed_summary.input: one terminal best_feasible_objective_at_budget_end per predetermined optimization seed

multi_profile_seed_paired_analysis.paired_difference: direction-normalized objective of profile_ids[1] minus direction-normalized objective of profile_ids[0]
multi_profile_seed_paired_analysis.zero_difference_rule: drop exact zero differences and report the effective paired sample size
multi_profile_seed_paired_analysis.p_value_rule: exact when the effective paired differences contain no ties; otherwise use a deterministic two-sided sign-flip permutation distribution with all permutations when feasible and 1000000 samples keyed by the campaign ID otherwise
multi_profile_seed_paired_analysis.multiplicity_family: all declared exact-case hypotheses within one campaign and one primary metric

global_non_pooling_rule: No observation, summary, effect size, hypothesis, or adjusted p-value may pool different case IDs or different problem semantic IDs.
